name: @pipeworx/mcp-archive

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Internet Archive for texts, audio, video, and software by keyword. Returns item titles, identifiers, descriptions, and media types.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default 20)

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get full metadata for an archived item by identifier. Returns title, creator, date, format, size, and access details.

tools.name: wayback_check
tools.description: Check if a URL was archived and retrieve the closest snapshot. Returns capture dates and direct link to the archived version.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the downloadable files for an archive.org item by identifier: name, format, size, and a constructed download_url. Use search / get_metadata first to find an identifier. (archive.org items, not Wayback snapshots.) Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-archive forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the archive pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
